mapper.sql: SELECT w.wip_id, w.wip_no, w.work_order_id, w.work_order_no, w.route_id, w.batch_id, w.batch_code, w.material_id, w.material_code, w.material_name, w.qty, w.qty_unit, w.wip_location, w.current_step_seq, w.current_process_name, w.step_start_time, w.plan_step_end, w.wip_status, w.finish_time, w.del_flag, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time, w.remark, CASE WHEN w.wip_status = '0' AND w.step_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, w.step_start_time, NOW()) / 24, 1) END AS wip_days FROM food_wip w
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO food_wip ( wip_no, work_order_id, work_order_no, route_id, batch_id, batch_code, material_id, material_code, material_name, qty, qty_unit, wip_location, current_step_seq, current_process_name, step_start_time, plan_step_end, wip_status, finish_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark )VALUES( #{wipNo}, #{workOrderId}, #{workOrderNo}, #{routeId}, #{batchId}, #{batchCode}, #{materialId}, #{materialCode}, #{materialName}, #{qty}, #{qtyUnit}, #{wipLocation}, #{currentStepSeq}, #{currentProcessName}, #{stepStartTime}, #{planStepEnd}, #{wipStatus}, #{finishTime}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{remark} )
mapper.delete:

#{wipId}
mapper.select: SELECT env_id, wip_id, wip_no, step_seq, process_name, record_time, temp, humidity, mold_status, recorder, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark FROM food_wip_env WHERE wip_id = #{wipId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY env_id DESC
mapper.delete: UPDATE food_wip_env SET del_flag = '2' WHERE env_id = #{envId}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('DP', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(w.wip_no, 4) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM food_wip w WHERE w.wip_no LIKE CONCAT('DP', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')

SELECT wo.work_order_no AS work_order_no, wo.product_id AS product_id, wo.product_code AS product_code, wo.product_name AS product_name, wo.route_id AS route_id, wo.unit AS unit FROM mms_work_order wo WHERE wo.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND wo.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT rp.process_name AS process_name, rp.std_days AS std_days, rp.min_days AS min_days, rp.max_days AS max_days, rp.temp_min AS temp_min, rp.temp_max AS temp_max, rp.humidity_min AS humidity_min, rp.humidity_max AS humidity_max, rp.loss_type AS loss_type, rp.loss_rate_max AS loss_rate_max, (SELECT MAX(rp2.step_seq) FROM mms_route_process rp2 WHERE rp2.route_id = #{routeId} AND rp2.del_flag = '0') AS max_seq FROM mms_route_process rp WHERE rp.route_id = #{routeId} AND rp.step_seq = #{stepSeq} AND rp.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT w.current_step_seq AS stepSeq, w.current_process_name AS processName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM food_wip w WHERE w.del_flag = '0' AND w.wip_status = '0' AND w.current_step_seq IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.current_step_seq, w.current_process_name ORDER BY w.current_step_seq

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalWip, IFNULL(AVG(CASE WHEN step_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, step_start_time, NOW()) / 24 END), 0) AS avgDays, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN plan_step_end IS NOT NULL AND plan_step_end < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdueCnt FROM food_wip WHERE del_flag = '0' AND wip_status = '0'
